coverImageAlt: A cyan prism separates light from an abstract stone sculpture into layered material textures.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: Deep artistic analysis represented by a faceted glass prism examining a small abstract sculpture and revealing layered material, cultural, emotional, and symbolic dimensions as distinct nonfigurative color-and-texture fields.
Scene/backdrop: A museum-like slate plinth in a warm paper gallery void.
Subject: One tactile abstract sculpture, a large cyan glass prism, and several carefully layered navy and orange projections made only of stone grain, woven fibers, water ripples, and branching organic textures.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; crop-safe sculpture-and-prism still life; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: contemplative, incisive, scholarly
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: projections must be purely nonfigurative material textures with no glyph-like patterns and no people or silhouettes; completely original image; no input or reference images; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, logos, trademarks, watermark, product UI, vendor branding, Microsoft Fluent styling, paw imagery, paw logo, cats, or cat silhouettes
